title: Parse INI files
prompt: Implement parse(text) in ini.js. Lines are `[section]`, `key = value`, blank, or comments starting with `;` or `#` (after optional whitespace). Keys and unquoted values are trimmed. A dotted section `[a.b]` nests: its keys go in result.a.b. Keys before any section go at the top level. An unquoted value ends at ` ;` or ` #` (whitespace then the comment character). A value in double quotes keeps its spaces and `;` and `#`, and understands `\"`, `\\` and `\n`. A line ending in a backslash continues on the next line (the backslash and line break are dropped, the next line's leading whitespace too). A key given twice in the same section becomes an array of its values in order. Any other line throws a SyntaxError whose message contains `line N` (1-based). Do not change test.js.
